title: Topic Discovery Agent output
description: LKM-only discovery for one topic. The Discovery Agent queries LKM and its paper graph, then returns no more than the configured candidate limit of specific open questions it judges worth research, each with a short handoff summary. The deterministic pipeline re-fetches and preserves the selected paper-graph records before Research begins. Discovery never downloads papers or web pages; Research verifies source fidelity and current status online.

selected_open_questions.description: Specific question records selected after inspecting LKM retrieval and the corresponding paper graph. global_id identifies the exact data.papers[].open_questions record; summary is the concise reason to hand this question to Research.

problem_summaries.description: Selected research leads reconstructed from LKM summaries when the topic_search route is enabled. summary is the concise Discovery-to-Research handoff, not a verified source-faithful formulation.
